name: vibes
description: Skills, reviewer agents and a commit gate for clean vibe coding, with style, idiom and tool guides for each language, format and tool.

plugins.name: vibes
plugins.description: Clean vibe coding: write a complete spec and design, spike to them, review with a panel of critic agents, then rebuild test-first in atomic, gated commits. Also profile-driven optimisation, reproduction-first debugging, architecture surveys, branch review, malicious pull request review, pull request writing, issue triage and pickup, questionnaires, prototypes, setup wizards, runbooks, plan grilling, parallel builds and session retrospectives. Also runs in Copilot CLI, Codex and Gemini CLI.
